notes.title: New Updates / System updates
notes.content:
FSR 3.0 
DLSS Support added
Created joystick support Optimized for Xbox/PS4/PS5 controllers
-----------
15 different weather conditions and weather events added
Fixed artifacts in trees
Voice speech support added
Added the ability to create a room and kick a user out of a room
Provided next gen lighting solutions for potential performance issues
Preparation of characters (Pilots, Campers, Scientists, Soldiers) to be added by Patreon users. (Patreon users will be mentioned in certain characters in the memberships they choose in the game.
Some members will still be mentioned in the story in notebooks for those who want to support)
Shader details of houses or certain objects have been added to add realism in weather events such as rain and snow Like wet woods
Fixed character not syncing position in some network states
Fixed optimization issues in Main Menu for users in closed beta   :CheckMark2:
